description: Fetch one bout by id. Pass include=stats for per-fight totals, include=rounds for round-by-round statistics, include=scorecards for the official judges’ cards, include=odds for the current UFCalendar consensus odds line (the closing line once the bout is settled) (information only, not betting advice).

fight_id.description: Bout id, as returned on an event card. Integer or numeric string.

include.description: Extra blocks to fetch in the same call. odds = the latest UFCalendar consensus line (information only, not betting advice).

name: get_fight
title: Get a bout
